chunks: And it is narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام that he said:
Indeed, I only dislike looking at the private parts of a Muslim; as for looking at the private parts of one who is not a Muslim, it is like looking at the private parts of a donkey.

key_terms.أَكْرَهُ: I dislike; I regard as reprehensible
key_terms.عَوْرَةِ: 'awrah; the private parts that are to be concealed
key_terms.مَنْ لَيْسَ بِمُسْلِمٍ: one who is not a Muslim

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about looking at the 'awrah of a Muslim and a non-Muslim?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام a ruling about looking at the 'awrah. It distinguishes between the 'awrah of a Muslim and that of a non-Muslim, expressing disapproval specifically regarding the former and likening the latter to the exposure of an animal.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.236 - On the authority of Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:
"Indeed, looking at the private parts of a Muslim is disliked, and looking at the private parts of a non-Muslim is like looking at the private parts of a donkey."
